scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,probe,openapi,docs --prefix-colors auto "bun run --cwd apps/web dev" "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:probe" "bun run --cwd apps/server docs:watch" "bun run --cwd apps/docs dev"
scripts.api:generate: bun run --filter server docs:generate && bun run --filter web gen
scripts.api:check: bun run api:generate && bun run api:validate && sh scripts/check-api-artifacts.sh
